status: Authored worked cases; not runtime or human tests

cases.title: Pendant blocks motive certainty but not a surface thought
cases.initialState: Bonded bearer wears pendant; item charge ready. Enemy legally casts reviewed Scribe Destiny, then another caster later casts Read Surface Thoughts.
steps: Scribe Destiny attempts to return the bearer's fundamental motive; pendant passive blocks that motive-certainty field.
No pendant charge is spent by passive protection.
Read Surface Thoughts later resolves normally: target WIS save 11+WIS2+PB3=16 against DC15 succeeds, so no thought is read.
cases.elapsedTime: Two spell resolutions; no added item time
cases.finalState: Pendant still ready; motive field blocked; surface-thought spell handled by its own reviewed procedure.

cases.title: Pendant consensual cancellation succeeds
cases.initialState: Bonded bearer within60ft perceives ally under one individually tracked ongoing spell branch; caster and ally are present and willing; charge=1.
steps: Bearer spends Action and names that one branch.
Caster and affected target each knowingly consent during that Action.
Consent completes; spend pendant charge and end that branch immediately.
Other target branches from same multi-target spell remain; no RP/slot/refund.
cases.finalState: Selected branch ended; charge 0 until qualifying beneficial Long Rest.

cases.title: Area spell is not a legal cancellation unit
cases.initialState: Bonded pendant charge=1; caster maintains fixed area spell with no individually tracked target effect.
steps: Bearer spends Action attempting contradiction.
Eligibility recheck finds no individual target effect matching relic procedure.
Action is spent; consent/cancellation never commits; charge remains.
cases.finalState: Area spell continues; pendant charge remains 1.

cases.title: Transfer cannot refresh pendant
cases.initialState: Bearer spent charge earlier. Pendant is handed to a second character after first bearer rests.
steps: Transfer ends old bond; item charge stays 0.
Second bearer performs 1 active hour bond.
Second bearer has not completed a beneficial Long Rest while bonded, so charge stays 0.
After a later legal beneficial Long Rest while bonded, charge refreshes to1.
cases.finalState: No swap-reset exploit; charge eventually 1 after valid refresh.

cases.title: Level 11 hesitation on melee spear attack
cases.initialState: Level11 Paladin is bonded and spear-proficient, STR+4, PB+4; target AC16; wearer Medium.
steps: Bonus Action Hesitation charges one attack for floor(11/2)=5 radiant.
Attack roll d20=12 +4 STR +4 PB =20 hits.
Damage roll 1d6=4 +4 piercing =8, plus flat5 radiant =13 total.
cases.finalState: Hit deals 8 piercing +5 radiant. Flat radiant is not doubled by critical rules.

cases.title: Miss consumes hesitation
cases.initialState: Level10 Soldier legally has spear proficiency from another source; bonded spear; DEX+3 chosen via Finesse; target AC18.
steps: Bonus Action charges floor(10/2)=5 radiant.
Attack roll 9+3+PB4=16 misses.
Charge expires with the declared attack.
cases.finalState: No damage; no stored radiant for later attack.

cases.title: Small wielder keeps Heavy disadvantage
cases.initialState: Small Paladin bonded and spear-proficient; attack normally would use DEX+4 via Finesse.
steps: Heavy applies disadvantage because wielder is Small.
Rolls 17 and8; use8. +4 DEX +4 PB=16 against AC17 misses.
cases.finalState: Finesse does not cancel Heavy disadvantage.

cases.title: Thrown spear does not return
cases.initialState: Level12 bonded Paladin holds spear; target 30ft away; no feature returns thrown weapons.
steps: Bonus Action Hesitation gives6 radiant.
Thrown attack is within20/60 long range and therefore uses actual range penalties; assume disadvantage rolls18/13, use13 + attack mods hits AC15.
Resolve spear damage +6 radiant.
Spear lands at target location and must be physically recovered.
cases.elapsedTime: one turn plus later movement/action as needed
cases.finalState: Spear no longer in wielder's hand; relic identity remains at landing location.

cases.title: Mirror advantage save succeeds
cases.initialState: Mirror intact, no pending benefit. User states fictional fear and touches mirror.
steps: Action activates; pending benefit starts for24h.
Next WIS save: base roll7 and advantage roll15; WIS+2+PB3 =>20 vs DC16 success.
Pending benefit is consumed; mirror remains intact.
cases.finalState: Mirror intact; no pending benefit.

cases.title: Legal reroll turns initial failure into success
cases.initialState: Pending mirror benefit applies to next WIS save; character has an independent legal reroll.
steps: Advantage dice 5/9; use9 +4 =13 vs DC15, initially failure.
Independent reroll legally replaces result with14+4=18 success.
Final save outcome is success, so mirror does not shatter.
cases.consumedStock: pending benefit plus independent reroll use
cases.finalState: Mirror intact.

cases.title: Final failed save shatters mirror
cases.initialState: Pending mirror benefit active; no rerolls.
steps: Advantage rolls3/8; +3=11 vs DC15 failure.
After final save outcome is known, pending benefit consumed and mirror shatters.
cases.finalState: Mirror shattered; reformation side scene may be used once if stock remains.

cases.title: Finite Sentinel reformation
cases.initialState: Same mirror shattered once; bearer has all three silver reflection tabs and recovered pieces.
steps: Bring pieces to Glass-Mender Sentinel side scene.
Spend2 uninterrupted hours; consume all3 tabs.
Mirror reforms as same item identity; EPI07 information-boon history unchanged.
cases.finalState: Mirror intact. If it shatters again, no reformation procedure in this module.

cases.title: Eligible observer reads Null Ink in known language
cases.initialState: Glove worn. Wearer knows Common and writes about current truce. Observer sincerely advocates peaceful passionless settlement and knows Common.
steps: Wearer spends Action writing 20 words within10ft.
Observer has line of sight and qualifying current stance, so glyphs resolve as actual Common words.
Observer reads them normally.
cases.finalState: One inscription active for10m.

cases.title: Eligible stance does not grant translation
cases.initialState: Observer qualifies by stance but does not know Old Choir cant; wearer writes in Old Choir cant.
steps: Observer sees meaningful glyph-text but lacks language comprehension.
No secret translation is granted; actual language procedure would be needed.
cases.finalState: Observer knows text exists but not its literal meaning.

cases.title: Ineligible copy is not allegiance detector
cases.initialState: Two observers view glyphs; one qualifies, one does not.
steps: Wearer receives no report of who can read.
Ineligible observer copies visible strokes onto paper.
Copied strokes are mundane shape data and do not later self-decode when stance changes.
cases.finalState: No loyalty/motive inference is mechanically produced.

cases.title: New inscription replaces old
cases.initialState: One active inscription has6m remaining.
steps: Wearer uses Action to write another inscription.
Old inscription ends immediately; new one starts fresh10m duration.
cases.finalState: Exactly one active inscription tied to glove.

cases.title: Memory Forge comfort route
cases.initialState: Party enters CH01; four Toy Sentinels active.
steps: PC1 uses Action CHA(Persuasion) DC14: roll11+CHA3+PB4=18, calms Toy1.
PC2 uses WIS(Insight) roll8+WIS2+PB4=14, calms Toy2.
PC3 Engineering repair 1m then roll10+INT2+PB4=16, calms Toy3.
PC4 attacks Toy4 to0HP; it becomes inert. East exit opens.
cases.finalState: All four resolved; Memory Ingot appears once.

cases.title: Unpainted Gallery neutral acknowledgement
cases.initialState: Party reveals three murals but player does not want to disclose detailed ambition.
steps: Three Object Interactions reveal safe fictional possibility images.
One character uses neutral statement 'These are possibilities, not commands.' after successful 10m INT(Investigation): roll9+INT3+PB4=16 vs14.
cases.finalState: North exit opens; one rubbing available.

cases.title: Echoless Vault pattern bypass
cases.initialState: Party enters CH03; Silence Wraith active.
steps: Spend10m INT(Investigation) DC14: roll12+INT2+PB4=18 reveals 1-3-5-7 plate pattern.
Four Actions depress sequence without moving carelessly.
North exit opens and Wraith pacifies; reliquary can be opened.
cases.finalState: Glove reliquary accessible; no combat required.

cases.title: Tessellation failed path uses catch-net
cases.initialState: One PC attempts row without successful pattern read.
steps: WIS(Perception) check roll6+2+4=12 vs14 fails, yields uncertainty.
PC chooses a path anyway; DEX save roll7+DEX2+PB4=13 vs14 fails.
PC slides10ft, falls Prone, takes d6=4 bludgeoning in catch-net.
cases.finalState: PC alive on catch-net; can retry/backtrack.

cases.title: Negative Feast restraint solution
cases.initialState: Four PCs sit; all request food.
steps: Serve one first portion to each of four PCs: four Actions.
Wait1 minute without taking a second portion.
Rule satisfied; north exit opens.
cases.finalState: 2 ration packs remain as finite reward; other projected food vanishes.

cases.title: Ladder Debris courage adaptation
cases.initialState: PC climbs four segments using Athletics+7.
steps: Segment1 roll8+7=15 success.
Segment2 roll5+7=12 fail; safety cable catches, d6=3 damage.
Retry segment2 roll11+7=18 success.
Segments3/4 rolls10/9 +7 succeed.
cases.finalState: PC reaches top; no fatal fall.

cases.title: Quiet Well Living mask boon
cases.initialState: Character wears operative Living mask and has Inspiration1/2.
steps: Spend1 uninterrupted minute at rim making fictional vow-related truthful statement.
Living-mask branch grants one temporary Inspiration d6, capped by existing pool.
cases.consumedStock: one chamber response for this identity
cases.finalState: Inspiration becomes2/2; no further response on revisits.

cases.title: Wax Seed strips destroyed but fallback works
cases.initialState: Only three of six wax strips survive because others were read aloud.
steps: Silent-read/copy three surviving strips, 3m.
Fewer than four remain, so use copper-tab fallback: 10m INT(Investigation) DC15, roll12+INT3+PB4=19 success.
Enter 2-5-1-6 sequence; east exit opens.
cases.finalState: Exit opens; no Equation/library qualification generated.

cases.title: Twin Wind tie resolves by fixed order
cases.initialState: Four party members: two vote Blue, two Amber before10m.
steps: Each places token via Action.
Votes tie2-2.
Fixed neutral tie rule selects Blue; Blue corridor solidifies, Amber seals.
cases.finalState: No duplicate party/timeline; choice fixed.

cases.title: Crimson Accord brokered before projections hit0
cases.initialState: Both projections above0HP.
steps: Round1 broker Action Persuasion: roll12+CHA3+PB4=19 vs15 success1.
Round2 second PC roll10+CHA2+PB4=16 success2 before either projection reaches0.
Duel ends in accord; east gate opens.
cases.finalState: Local Favor Mark created; Concord Spear appears once.

cases.title: Shardpool full four-card expedition
cases.initialState: Six travelers fit 20×20 landing cells; deck unused.
steps: Draw/activate four cards sequentially on separate visits; cards are without replacement.
Each swap lasts exactly10m and auto-returns before same-timestamp event.
Harvest/use only finite contents; after fourth successful activation deck empty.
cases.finalState: No general plane travel remains; all four destination stocks now reflect actual depletion.

cases.title: Omega Theatre neutral prompt avoids personal disclosure
cases.initialState: All players decline detailed fictional vow narration, but one uses neutral prompt.
steps: Character Action states 'My character admits the vow is unresolved.'
Theatre accepts branch and opens exit after1m.
Mirror rises from trap.
cases.finalState: No Echo Doppelganger; Mirror available once.

cases.title: Hourly exposure imposes Veil
cases.initialState: Character enters Field A with accumulator0, WIS save bonus+5.
steps: Remain60m continuously; accumulator reaches60 and resets by60.
WIS save roll7+5=12 vs15 fails.
Apply Null Veil; field accumulator0.
cases.finalState: Veil active; passive Insight=5; future damage roots re-evaluate as Null-nonlethal unless suppressed.

cases.title: Exit and re-entry does not reset partial exposure
cases.initialState: Field A accumulator35m.
steps: Exit20m: accumulator pauses35.
Re-enter and remain25m: reaches60.
WIS save roll13+3=16 succeeds; no Veil.
cases.finalState: Accumulator0; no Veil.

cases.title: HP10/max20 takes40 from Veiled dealer
cases.initialState: Living significant target HP10/max20, 0 temp,0Wounds. Root dealer has unsuppressed Veil; resolved damage40.
steps: Mark root nullNonlethal at creation.
Apply mitigation/temp (none); HP falls to0.
Override Instant Death even though40-10>=20; skip Wound save/death failures.
Target becomes Unconscious/Stable and receives normal stable recovery deadline.
cases.finalState: Target Stable0, no new Wound/death failure; old states otherwise preserved.

cases.title: Preexisting three Wounds are not erased
cases.initialState: Target HP3/max20, three existing Wounds. Veiled dealer deals resolved8.
steps: HP goes0.
Null-nonlethal packet skips Wound-save creation, so preexisting Critical state does not create a fatal failed Wound save.
Target becomes Stable0; three Wounds remain.
cases.finalState: Stable0 with3Wounds; Veil did not heal/remove Wounds.

cases.title: Stable0 target hit again by Null-nonlethal packet
cases.initialState: Living target already Stable0. Veiled dealer creates10-damage root.
steps: Packet resolves at0HP.
No death-save failure, Wound save or Instant Death from this packet.
Target remains Stable0; establish/retain normal stable recovery deadline without farming multiple deadlines.
cases.finalState: Stable0, no failures.

cases.title: Delayed packet keeps creation-time flag
cases.initialState: Veiled caster creates a delayed damage effect at t0; then succeeds on shrug before delayed hit resolves.
steps: At t0 root is marked nullNonlethal=true.
Shrug success later suppresses Veil for one round.
Delayed descendant resolves during suppression but inherits root flag from creation.
Living target at positive HP can reach0 only under nonlethal override.
cases.consumedStock: actual ability costs outside this module
cases.finalState: No retroactive lethal conversion.

cases.title: Shared damage retains root nonlethal flag
cases.initialState: Veiled attacker deals finalized root that is legally split/transferred by existing damage-sharing feature.
steps: Root marked nullNonlethal before transfer.
Existing sharing procedure divides packet once.
Each recipient resolves its branch with nullNonlethal flag; no extra root/resource trigger from transfer.
Ordinary defenses follow actual sharing stage.
cases.finalState: Neither branch creates Wounds/death failures/Instant Death from this root.

cases.title: Failed shrug has finite Incapacitated duration
cases.initialState: Veiled character in initiative can take Bonus Action, CHA save bonus+4.
steps: Spend Bonus Action; roll8+4=12 vs15 failure.
Apply Incapacitated through end of character's next regular turn; concentration ends immediately.
After duration ends, Veil remains and character can attempt again on a later legal turn.
cases.finalState: No indefinite lock; no purge occurred.

cases.title: Bittersap successful harvest
cases.initialState: One of6 Bittersap nodes unused; harvester Nature+5, Survival+6 with knife.
steps: Recognition10m: roll10+5=15 vs14 identifies plant.
Harvest20m: roll11+6=17 vs14 success.
Consume one node; gain1 part (0.1lb).
cases.finalState: 5 nodes remain; 1 fresh part with7-day shelf life.

cases.title: Failed Echo Lily harvest consumes bloom
cases.initialState: Four Echo Lily blooms; DEX(Herbalism kit)+5.
steps: Recognition succeeds.
Harvest roll6+5=11 vs14 Failure.
Bloom wilts and yields0.
cases.finalState: 3 blooms remain; no ingredient gained.

cases.title: Successful antidote brew and dose
cases.initialState: Inventory:2 Bittersap parts,1 Echo Lily,1 pint flame water, pot, herbalism kit; patient Veiled and willing.
steps: Begin boil; consume all ingredients.
Work30m; INT(Herbalism kit) roll12+4=16 vs15 Success ->1 dose,7-day shelf life.
Use Action to feed willing patient within5ft.
Dose consumed; purge Veil.
cases.consumedStock: 2 Bittersap,1 Echo Lily,1 flame-water flask,1 dose
cases.finalState: Patient no longer Veiled; continuing field exposure accumulator remains.

cases.title: Failed brew consumes ingredients
cases.initialState: Same ingredients; brewer modifier+2.
steps: Consume ingredients at boil start.
30m check roll8+2=10 vs15 Failure.
No dose; pot needs10m cleaning.
cases.finalState: No antidote produced; finite stock reduced.

cases.title: Unconscious patient who can swallow may be dosed
cases.initialState: Veiled living patient is Incapacitated/Unconscious but Director determines swallowing is physically possible; one dose in hand.
steps: Helper uses Action within5ft and feeds dose under current consumable procedure.
Dose purges Veil; it does not heal HP or end Unconscious by itself.
cases.finalState: Veil removed; underlying zeroHP/Unconscious state unchanged.

cases.title: Flame-water access exhausted
cases.initialState: CH11 Crystal Bastion landing stock of6 flasks has all been removed/consumed; no separately authored source exists.
steps: Party has Bittersap/Echo Lily but zero flame water.
Home-plane affiliation and prior Concord Step do not create stock.
Antidote work cannot legally begin.
cases.finalState: Recipe blocked until actual lawful flame water is acquired elsewhere by future authored content.

cases.title: Direct HP cost is not converted
cases.initialState: Veiled character must pay a legal 5 HP sacrificial cost; current HP10.
steps: Payment is direct HP loss, not damage.
Null nonlethal rule does not apply.
Pay5 HP; current HP becomes5, subject to source's own minimum/payment rules.
cases.finalState: No Stable conversion, no Null prevention trigger.

cases.title: Independent companion damage stays lethal-capable
cases.initialState: Veiled Ranger controls an independent beast companion that is not Veiled; companion attacks ordinary monster.
steps: Controller's Veil does not mark companion as dealer.
Companion damage root has nullNonlethal=false.
Resolve ordinary Core damage/death rules for target.
cases.finalState: Veil does not spread through ownership/control.

cases.title: Veiled damage disables construct creature at zero
cases.initialState: Construct creature HP6; Veiled character deals resolved10.
steps: Root marked nullNonlethal.
Construct HP becomes0.
Instead of destroyed/Dead, apply local Disabled: Incapacitated, Speed0.
No Wound/death-save mechanics are created.
cases.finalState: Construct Disabled0 until an actual applicable repair/heal restores function.

cases.title: New reflected packet re-evaluates reflector
cases.initialState: Original attacker is Veiled; target has an exact reflection effect that creates new reflected damage and is not Veiled.
steps: Original attack root is nullNonlethal.
Reflection effect creates a new damage root whose dealer is reflector.
Reflector is not Veiled, so reflected root is not Null-nonlethal.
Resolve reflected packet under ordinary Core rules.
cases.finalState: Original and reflected roots can have different lethality flags without duplicate transfer triggers.

cases.title: Unwilling active patient cannot be force-dosed
cases.initialState: Helper holds one antidote dose; Veiled patient is conscious, active and unwilling within5ft.
steps: Equipment procedure provides no free forced oral administration against unwilling active creature.
Helper cannot spend dose as successful administration without another exact restraint/feeding authorization.
cases.finalState: Dose remains; Veil remains.
